fine_lines.title: will vs might
fine_lines.explanation_ar: will تعني أنك متأكد أن الشيء سيحدث في المستقبل. might تعني أنه ممكن أن يحدث وممكن لا (غير متأكد). لذلك غضبت ريبيكا عندما قالت آنا: You might get a job، لأن might تعني أيضاً «وقد لا تحصل».
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Will" means you are sure something happens in the future. "Might" means it is possible, but you are not sure. That is why Rebecca was upset: "might" also means "might not".

examples.sentence: I will call you after class.
The shop will open at nine.
I might call you tonight, or I might not.
Take an umbrella. It might rain.

fine_lines.title: won't vs might not
fine_lines.explanation_ar: won't = will not: نفي مؤكد (لن). might not: نفي غير مؤكد (ربما لا).
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Won't" (will not) is a sure no. "Might not" means maybe not.

examples.sentence: I won't be late. I promise.
I'm tired. I might not go to the party.

expressions.phrase: I might go. I might not go.
expressions.meaning_en: Maybe I will go, maybe I won't. I am not sure.
expressions.example: "Are you coming tomorrow?" "I might. I might not."

expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to ask for help.
expressions.example: Can you help me with this bag?

expressions.meaning_en: You say this when you like someone's suggestion.

expressions.example: Be careful! The plate is hot.
Check your bag. Things might go wrong on the trip.

expressions.meaning_ar: ماذا يمكن أن يحدث من خطأ؟
expressions.meaning_en: You think there is no danger (often said before a problem!).
expressions.example: It's an easy job. What can go wrong?

expressions.meaning_en: Do not feel nervous; everything is fine.
expressions.example: Don't worry! I have the keys.

expressions.phrase: Tell me what I am thinking.
expressions.meaning_en: Asking someone to guess your thoughts.
expressions.example: You know me well. Tell me what I am thinking.

expressions.meaning_en: Yes, that is what I want to do.
expressions.example: "You will finish at five?" "That's the plan."

expressions.meaning_en: A friendly reply when you help someone.
You said exactly what I was thinking.
expressions.example: "Do you want some tea?" "Yes! You read my mind!"

expressions.meaning_en: Said to someone before something difficult.
expressions.example: You have an exam today? Good luck!
That's all for today. Until next time!

grammar.title: Future with will
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم will + الفعل في المصدر (بدون to) للحديث عن المستقبل عندما نكون متأكدين. will لا تتغير مع الضمائر: I will, she will, they will. الاختصار: I'll, you'll. النفي: will not = won't. السؤال: نقدم will: Will you come?
grammar.explanation_en: Use will + base verb to talk about the future when you are sure. "Will" is the same for all subjects. Short forms: I'll, you'll. Negative: will not = won't. Question: put will first: Will you come?
examples: You will get a job writing the news.

grammar.title: Possibility with might
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم might + الفعل في المصدر عندما يكون الشيء ممكناً لكن غير مؤكد. النفي: might not (عادة بدون اختصار). might أيضاً لا تتغير مع الضمائر ولا نضيف لها s.
grammar.explanation_en: Use might + base verb when something is possible but not sure. Negative: might not. "Might" never changes and never takes -s.
examples: I might go to the party.

grammar.title: Short answers and tag questions with will
grammar.explanation_ar: في الإجابات القصيرة نكرر will فقط: Will you go? – Yes, I will. / No, I won't. وفي الأسئلة الذيلية: إذا كانت الجملة مثبتة نستخدم won't في الذيل، وإذا كانت منفية نستخدم will: I will have a wedding, won't I? / She won't say no, will she?
grammar.explanation_en: In short answers repeat only "will": Yes, I will. / No, I won't. In tag questions, a positive sentence takes "won't...?" and a negative sentence takes "will...?".

questions.question: Which sentence means you are SURE?
questions.explanation_ar: will تعبر عن التأكد، أما might فتعبر عن الاحتمال.
questions.explanation_en: "Will" shows you are sure; "might" shows only a possibility.

questions.question: Take an umbrella. It ___ rain this afternoon (it is possible).

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: She will to graduate next year.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد will يأتي الفعل في المصدر بدون to وبدون s، وwill نفسها لا تأخذ s.
questions.explanation_en: After "will" use the base verb: no "to", no "-s".

questions.question: What is the short form of "will not"?
Rebecca is a "junior in college". This means she is in ___.
questions.explanation_ar: junior طالب في السنة الثالثة من أربع سنوات.
questions.explanation_en: A junior is in the third year of a four-year college.

questions.question: She won't say no, ___?
questions.explanation_ar: الجملة منفية (won't) فالذيل يكون مثبتاً: will she?
questions.explanation_en: The sentence is negative, so the tag is positive: will she?

questions.question: "Do you want a cup of tea?" "Yes! You ___ my mind!"

questions.explanation_en: "You read my mind" means you knew what I was thinking.

questions.explanation_ar: journalism هي الصحافة: كتابة الأخبار ونقلها.

questions.question: "Will you be careful?" Choose the correct short answer.
questions.explanation_ar: في الإجابة القصيرة نكرر الفعل المساعد will: Yes, I will.
questions.explanation_en: Repeat "will" in the short answer: Yes, I will.
